editor.description: The Tiptap editor instance, usually created with `useEditor`. Renders nothing until the editor is ready.

disabled.description: Dims the content area and blocks pointer events. Disable the editor itself with Tiptap's `editable` option.

variant.description: `fixed` sits above the content, `sticky` follows the scroll position, `floating` is a panel for use inside a bubble menu.

stickyOffset.description: Distance from the top of the scroll container, used by the `sticky` variant.

editorProps.description: ProseMirror view props forwarded to Tiptap's `EditorContent`.

label.description: Accessible name for the button, also shown as its tooltip.

icon.description: The icon rendered inside the button.

label.description: Accessible name for the control, also shown as its tooltip.

icon.description: The icon component rendered inside the button.

command.description: Runs when the control is clicked, usually a chained Tiptap command.

getVariant.description: Derives the button variant from the editor state, typically `subtle` when the mark is active.

isDisabled.description: Disables the control based on the editor state, for example when the command can't run.

getProps.description: Props derived from the editor state. Takes precedence over `getVariant`.

label.description: Accessible name for the select, also shown as its tooltip.

options.description: The selectable options, each with a `value`, `label` and optional `icon`.

getValue.description: Derives the selected option value from the editor state.

command.description: Runs when an option is selected.

renderValue.description: Customizes how the selected option is rendered in the trigger.

placeholder.description: Shown when the current editor state matches none of the options.

label.description: Accessible name for the control, also shown as its tooltip.

swatches.description: The colors shown in the popover, each with a `value` and a `color`.

getValue.description: Derives the active color from the editor state.

command.description: Runs when a swatch is picked.

showRemove.description: Adds a close button to the popover that clears the color.

onRemove.description: Runs when the remove button is clicked.

icon.description: Icon rendered above the color bar in the trigger.
